rules: One classification per register office_id, including 28 historical communal councils.
Draft tier labels are unchanged: 128 municipal / 0 regional / 1 national / 1 other.
Communal councils are municipal. Cantons and districts are geography, not regional offices.
Chambre des Députés is national. The EP delegation is other.
No Grand Duke or mayor popular contest is added. LU-G01 and LU-G02 stay resolved exclusions.
Per-office review_status stays needs_review. File status is approved with LU-G03–LU-G11 left open.
Merger edges stay the 28 explicit portal predecessors. Missing 1994 EP votes are not invented.
notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-22 America/Edmonton with holds LU-G03 through LU-G11 open. LU-G01 and LU-G02 are documented resolved exclusions, not closed research holds. No Grand Duke or mayor popular contest, guessed merger edge, or missing 1994 EP vote was added.

approval.notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-22 Prompt AO with holds LU-G03 through LU-G11 left open. LU-G01 (Grand Duke) and LU-G02 (mayors) remain resolved exclusions: no popular office invented. 102 current + 28 historical offices (130); 438 events; 48197 result observations in the full pack. Draft tiers 128 municipal / 0 regional / 1 national / 1 other. Direct executives 0. 28 explicit merger edges only. 1994 EP Grevenmacher LSAP votes stay missing. Per-office review_status stays needs_review. results.json and sources/ omitted from this slim land. No Luxembourg importer in this landing.
